question:
What is the value of

\[4(299) + 3(299) + 2(299) + 298?\]
solution:
The first three terms give \(4+3+2=9\) copies of \(299\). Also, \(298=299-1\), so adding the last term gives ten copies of \(299\), then subtracts \(1\). Therefore the value is
\[10\cdot299-1=2990-1=2989.\]
The answer is \(2989\), choice B.
